TEST FIXTURE - FICTIONAL SCHEME FOR AUTOMATED TESTS ONLY. NOT REAL GOVERNMENT INFORMATION.

1. Name of the scheme
Test Straw Support Scheme for the district of Exampleville.

2. Incentive for not burning
Farmers who manage paddy straw without burning receive Rs 1,000 per acre, paid into their bank account after field verification.

3. How to apply
Register the paddy area on the test portal before 30 November and upload a photo of the field.

4. Penalty
Burning paddy straw attracts a fine of Rs 2,500 for land below 2 acres.
